item.title: GEMA to sell Zebralution to DistroKid investor Insight Holdings
item.description: German collecting society GEMA has agreed to sell digital distribution company Zebralution to the US-based investment firm Insight Holdings Group, a key investor in DistroKid. The transaction is subject to regulatory approval. GEMA confirmed that it will sell 100 per cent of Zebralution to Insight Holdings, which invests through its growth equity arm, Insight Partners. item.title: ZIMURA board dispute deepens as artists demand answers
item.description: A governance dispute at the Zimbabwe Music Rights Association (ZIMURA) has intensified, with rival board factions issuing conflicting statements and musicians demanding answers amid allegations of misconduct and financial mismanagement. The latest developments follow controversy surrounding the disposal of ZIMURA property, which has triggered internal divisions and public exchanges between board members. item.title: MIAF begins rollout of IP training for creative and cultural industries
item.description: The Music In Africa Foundation (MIAF) has begun implementing its training programme for participants in the National Employment Facility for Creative Industries in South Africa (NEFCISA). item.title: CTIJF reveals line-up and new look ahead of March
item.description: The Cape Town International Jazz Festival (CTIJF) has announced the first phase of its artist line-up for the 27th and 28th March event, alongside the unveiling of a new visual identity for the festival. The refreshed branding marks a shift towards a more contemporary aesthetic and has prompted discussion across social media platforms. item.title: Open call: The Music Imbizo 2026 showcases in SA
item.description: The Music Imbizo has opened submissions for its 2026 showcase programme, scheduled to take place in Durban, South Africa later in the year. The Music Imbizo is a platform focused on music as an art form, business sector and cultural practice. It brings together musicians, music industry professionals, emerging creatives and entrepreneurs, cultural practitioners, policymakers, media and audiences. item.title: Namibian TikToker Luiza Fatima builds her musical identity across borders
item.description: By Tendani Mungoni and Sibongile Kobo Namibian TikToker and artist Luiza Fatima is steadily shaping her musical identity with each song she writes and every performance she records. In a conversation with Music In Africa’s Tshifhiwa Tendani Mungoni and Sibongile Kobo, she reflected on navigating her Namibian identity while living in South Africa, developing her confidence, and confronting the realities of the music industry. item.title: SA: Trigo shares new EP Gracefully Broken
item.description: South African house music producer and DJ Trigo has released a new EP titled Gracefully Broken. The six-track project is available for streaming and download on major digital platforms. According to the artist, Gracefully Broken is a solo project that incorporates sampled vocals from various artists. item.title: SA: Apple Music reveals December’s top songs and artists
item.description: Apple Music has released its Ke Dezemba overview, identifying the artists and songs that dominated listening and Shazam activity in South Africa during the festive season. According to the platform, Kelvin Momo, Kabza De Small and Thukutela were the most-streamed artists on Apple Music in December. item.title: Corona Sunsets Festival returns to Cape Town on 21 March
item.description: The Corona Sunsets Festival is set to return to Cape Town on 21 March 2026, transforming Clifton’s coastline into a day-long celebration of music and culture. The festival will be headlined by Grammy Award winners Purple Disco Machine and Zakes Bantwini, with performances from Sun El Musician, Msaki and a special sunset set by the Ndlovu Youth Choir.
